datasets.name: The Vienna 4x22 Piano Corpus
datasets.version: 1.0.0 match-file ecosystem when using CPJKU/vienna4x22 metadata
datasets.notes: Real piano audio, performance MIDI, MusicXML score, and alignment/match data are useful for pipeline testing but were not captured against the NoteVerse configured Practice clock.

datasets.name: MAESTRO
datasets.version: v2/v3 metadata only unless explicitly selected locally
datasets.notes: Both frozen candidates document MAESTRO-family exposure; do not use for official ByteDance-vs-Online-AMT selection.

datasets.name: ASAP / nASAP
datasets.notes: ASAP audio is MAESTRO-derived in common uses; keep as diagnostic metadata unless future provenance proves otherwise.

datasets.name: Saarland Music Data MIDI-Audio Piano Music
datasets.notes: Real human Disklavier performances with synchronized audio/MIDI, but score identity must be bound independently before product metrics.

datasets.name: MAPS
datasets.notes: Useful for isolated acoustic regression; not a same-take human NoteVerse Practice benchmark.

datasets.name: GiantMIDI-Piano
datasets.notes: Symbolic/transcribed corpus; not same-take physical acoustic truth.
